response.sql: SELECT ra.raceId, ra.name, AVG(CAST(NULLIF(NULLIF(r.laps, '\N'), '') AS REAL)) AS avg_laps FROM results r JOIN races ra ON ra.raceId = r.raceId WHERE r.positionOrder > 12 GROUP BY ra.raceId, ra.name ORDER BY avg_laps IS NULL, avg_laps DESC LIMIT 10;

assumptions.assumption: Missing `laps` values are stored as the text '\N' or as an empty string; both are excluded before averaging, and AVG ignores the resulting NULLs. A race whose results all lack laps gets a NULL average and sorts last.

The filter `positionOrder > 12` applies to individual result rows, and the average is taken over those filtered rows for each race. Races with no result row above position 12 do not appear in the output.
